title.from: M7 Provisioning, onboarding, lifecycle, export and deletion; reader features for tenants
title.to: M7 Design partner's three sites live on the shared tier: data-only provisioning, sign-in, brand, lifecycle, cost, isolation gates

description.from:
Milestone of epic PPY-6a6357 (initiative PPY-25ffa3). Critical-path plan: PPY-e38a2d. Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305).

Entry criteria: TI cut over (PPY-e51189; the 14-day close is not required), M6, and the Prospectus changes deployed: deployment records and API for product papyrus (kanbus-271b4a), shared sign-in bound to a deployment (kanbus-3e5e82), lifecycle events (kanbus-6efecd) with billing standing (kanbus-b19d5a), shared-tier cost accounting (kanbus-f45f7f), and the Prospectus security review of all of that (kanbus-fa72e8).
Exit criteria (the gate for the design partner's sites, PPY-37f2ec): on production, a site is created by a data change only: a deployment record created through the Prospectus API (operator-triggered for the partner; self-serve checkout is M8) causes Papyrus to provision the tenant (PPY-70a429) from the starter template (PPY-3aa10f) with entitlements (PPY-2321aa), reachable at <site>.p.apyr.us, admins signing in with the shared Google client on newsroom.p.apyr.us; lifecycle applied (PPY-d7274f); export (PPY-e882ee) and deletion (PPY-62f10d) work; abuse takedown (PPY-d7c279); provisioning security review passed (PPY-1da916); the end-to-end check PPY-e54eca green on staging and production.
Customer-visible: Internal and partner tenants can be created by data in production.
Index-adding deploys in this milestone: None.
Contains: PPY-70a429, PPY-3aa10f, PPY-2321aa, PPY-d7274f, PPY-e882ee, PPY-62f10d, PPY-d7c279, PPY-1da916, PPY-966ef5, PPY-6cb44b, PPY-e54eca
Not gating M7 unless the partner needs them at launch (decision D6): PPY-810f42 onboarding, PPY-91fb68 preview, reader features PPY-6b084f, PPY-5219fc, PPY-d0a3d5, PPY-1f83a6; PPY-496c0b bring-your-own Google client.
Follows: M5 (cut-over), M6.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
Scenario: A new shared-tier site is created with no code change (features_backend/tenant-provisioning.feature, PPY-966ef5)
Scenario: The per-site cap does not apply to shared-tier sites (same file)
Scenario: A deployment record creates one tenant even when the event repeats (same file, PPY-70a429)
Scenario: A half-finished provisioning resumes (same file)
Scenario: A new site passes every platform policy check (features_backend/starter-site.feature, PPY-3aa10f)
Scenario: An action outside the plan is refused with a plain message (features_backend/tenant-entitlements.feature, PPY-2321aa)
Scenario: Fourteen days past due makes editing read-only (features_backend/tenant-lifecycle.feature, PPY-6cb44b)
Scenario: A suspended tenant can read and export but not write (same file, PPY-d7274f)
Scenario: Export holds everything and only the tenant's data (features_backend/tenant-export.feature, PPY-e882ee)
Scenario: Deletion leaves nothing behind (features_backend/tenant-deletion.feature, PPY-62f10d)
Scenario: A burst of site creations is stopped and reported (features_backend/provisioning-controls.feature, PPY-1da916)
Scenario: A forged provisioning event creates nothing (same file)
Scenario: A token for one deployment cannot act on another (same file, PPY-1da916; Prospectus kanbus-3e5e82)
Scenario: An operator takes a site offline without deleting it (features_backend/tenant-abuse-controls.feature, PPY-d7c279)
Scenario: A deployment record reaches a live site with no human step (PPY-e54eca)

Acceptance checks:
1. On production: create an internal test deployment through the Prospectus API; within the provisioning time budget the site serves at <id>.p.apyr.us; git log in Papyrus and Prospectus shows no commit and the deploy history shows no deploy for it; Cognito callback list unchanged.
2. Replay the same deployment event three times: one Tenant row, one admin membership, one projection.
3. Export the test tenant and reopen it as a dedicated site in a sandbox; delete it and run the verified-empty check.
4. Both security reviews (PPY-1da916, kanbus-fa72e8) closed with findings fixed or accepted in writing by Ryan.
5. Every item of the readiness checklist on PPY-37f2ec ticked with evidence.
description.to:
Milestone of epic PPY-6a6357 (initiative PPY-25ffa3). Critical-path plan: PPY-e38a2d. Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305).

M7 is the launch of the design partner's three sites DIRECTLY on the shared tier (Ryan, 2026-11-08; never dedicated first). It therefore includes everything those sites need to be live.

Entry criteria: TI cut over (PPY-e51189; the 14-day close is not required); M3 isolation gates; M4 shared serving and site as data; M6 cost accounting and metering; the Prospectus changes deployed: deployment records and API for product papyrus (kanbus-271b4a), shared sign-in bound to a deployment (kanbus-3e5e82), lifecycle events (kanbus-6efecd) with billing standing (kanbus-b19d5a), shared-tier cost accounting (kanbus-f45f7f), and Prospectus's security review (kanbus-fa72e8).
Exit criteria: on production, sites are created by a data change only: a deployment record created through the Prospectus API (operator-triggered for the partner) makes Papyrus provision the tenant (PPY-70a429) from the starter template (PPY-3aa10f) with entitlements (PPY-2321aa); branding and layout set as data (SiteConfig, BrandPack, preset); reachable at <site>.p.apyr.us (and custom domains if the partner brings them, PPY-966722); admins sign in with the shared Google client on newsroom.p.apyr.us (PPY-fdbbd7); lifecycle applied (PPY-d7274f); export (PPY-e882ee) and deletion (PPY-62f10d); abuse takedown (PPY-d7c279); provisioning security review passed (PPY-1da916); external security review done (decision D22, default yes); cost attributed per deployment (PPY-25e0d7, PPY-3fd951, PPY-49d059, PPY-889ab5); the end-to-end check PPY-e54eca green; and the partner's three sites live (PPY-37f2ec).
Customer-visible: the design partner's three sites, live on the shared tier.
Index-adding deploys in this milestone: None.
Contains: PPY-37f2ec, PPY-70a429, PPY-3aa10f, PPY-2321aa, PPY-d7274f, PPY-e882ee, PPY-62f10d, PPY-d7c279, PPY-1da916, PPY-966ef5, PPY-6cb44b, PPY-e54eca, PPY-3ff465 (gate 2 moved here by default)
Not gating M7 unless the partner needs them at launch (decision D6): PPY-810f42 guided onboarding (the operator can set brand and settings as data instead), PPY-91fb68 preview, reader features PPY-6b084f, PPY-5219fc, PPY-d0a3d5, PPY-1f83a6; PPY-496c0b bring-your-own Google client.
Follows: M5 (cut-over), M6.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
Scenario: A partner site goes live on the shared tier by a data change only (PPY-37f2ec)
Scenario: A partner site's cost is attributed to its deployment (PPY-37f2ec)
Scenario: A new shared-tier site is created with no code change (features_backend/tenant-provisioning.feature, PPY-966ef5)
Scenario: The per-site cap does not apply to shared-tier sites (same file)
Scenario: A deployment record creates one tenant even when the event repeats (same file, PPY-70a429)
Scenario: A half-finished provisioning resumes (same file)
Scenario: A new site passes every platform policy check (features_backend/starter-site.feature, PPY-3aa10f)
Scenario: An action outside the plan is refused with a plain message (features_backend/tenant-entitlements.feature, PPY-2321aa)
Scenario: Fourteen days past due makes editing read-only (features_backend/tenant-lifecycle.feature, PPY-6cb44b)
Scenario: A suspended tenant can read and export but not write (same file, PPY-d7274f)
Scenario: Export holds everything and only the tenant's data (features_backend/tenant-export.feature, PPY-e882ee)
Scenario: Deletion leaves nothing behind (features_backend/tenant-deletion.feature, PPY-62f10d)
Scenario: A burst of site creations is stopped and reported (features_backend/provisioning-controls.feature, PPY-1da916)
Scenario: A forged provisioning event creates nothing (same file)
Scenario: A token for one deployment cannot act on another (same file, PPY-1da916; Prospectus kanbus-3e5e82)
Scenario: An operator takes a site offline without deleting it (features_backend/tenant-abuse-controls.feature, PPY-d7c279)
Scenario: A deployment record reaches a live site with no human step (PPY-e54eca)

Acceptance checks:
1. On production: an internal test deployment created through the Prospectus API serves at <id>.p.apyr.us within the provisioning time budget; git and deploy history show no change for it; Cognito callback list unchanged.
2. Replaying the same deployment event three times gives one Tenant row, one admin membership, one projection.
3. Export of the test tenant reopens as a dedicated site in a sandbox; deletion passes the verified-empty check.
4. Both provisioning reviews (PPY-1da916, kanbus-fa72e8) and, by default, the external review closed with findings fixed or accepted in writing by Ryan.
5. Every readiness item on PPY-37f2ec ticked with evidence; the three partner sites serve, their admins sign in, and their cost appears per deployment in the Prospectus ledger.
